#253 · Wood Gecko Pokémon

Grovyle

Grass

Hoenn · Generation 3

Grovyle is a Grass-type Wood Gecko Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.9 m tall and weighs 21.6 kg. It evolves from Treecko and into Sceptile. Its highest base stat is Speed (95), with a base stat total of 405.
